issues.description: { ...s } is a SHALLOW copy: next.ui is the same object as s.ui. Assigning next.ui.theme therefore mutates the caller's s.ui.theme too, contradicting the JSDoc promise 'leaving the original untouched'. Callers relying on immutability (undo, memoised selectors) break. Needs a nested copy: { ...s, ui: { ...s.ui, theme } }.
